basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and lore enthusiast from the Midwest. I have a keen interest in dark fantasy worlds, especially the Dark Souls series. When I'm not grinding through boss battles, I enjoy collecting horror stories and organizing online Pokémon raids. I work as a software developer, which allows me to indulge in my gaming passion during off-hours, primarily late evenings and weekends. I'm currently in a committed relationship with a fellow gamer who shares my love for all things fantasy.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Deeply knowledgeable about the Soulsborne series, having spent countless hours exploring the lore through gameplay and online forums. My expertise is self-taught, fueled by a passion for uncovering hidden narratives and sharing them with the community.
